counting_notes: 52 task identities come from six batch manifests. Report existence is recorded; completion is not inferred from directory or extraction-file presence.
Finding clusters count source-report findings or concern bullets, not tasks and not proven scoring errors. Original worker classifications are preserved, not independently adjudicated here.

Affected criteria deduplicate criterion IDs within each task and classification; the confirmed_or_arguable union also deduplicates across those two classifications. A criterion ID in different tasks remains a different criterion.

Markdown range/shorthand criterion references are expanded. Explicit no-defect checks are counted separately as qualified_check. Arguable sections may contain other qualifications; consult the report before interpreting them as defects.
Source-only issues without criterion IDs count as clusters but cannot contribute to affected-criterion counts. Unverified and qualified checks are excluded from confirmed_or_arguable.
Coverage is reported by workers. Extraction and criterion-directed passage inspection do not establish exhaustive source reading or independent validation of every legal proposition.
This index does not read or evaluate solver outputs, does not join actual grades, and does not establish any score adjustment.
